name: Protecting Children
overview: Scripture reveals that children are a precious heritage from the Lord, entrusted to us as His reward and responsibility. The Lord’s care and protection extend even to the smallest ones, with Christ warning sternly against causing them harm and reminding us that their angels behold the Father’s face in heaven. Believers are called to faithfully train and guide children in the way they should go, ensuring their spiritual foundation endures, while trusting in God's sovereign hand to guard and save amidst trials.
